intent_contract.text: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.

The requester authorizes independent randomized complex photographic authorship and an actual reference-based render test. The selected experiment is a ceramic artist with muted-on-vivid contrast, diagonal color split and geometric color blocking; these are agent-authored experimental interpretations, not user definitions.

Create a photographic gallery portrait of an adult ceramic artist arranging monumental glaze samples in a theatrical ceramics studio. Use the attached portrait as the appearance reference, retaining the recognizable face, long dark wavy hair, and natural skin texture. The artist wears a matte desaturated clay-gray coverall and stands behind a waist-high pale stone workbench, both feet planted on the floor. Her left palm rests flat on the workbench while her bent right arm extends forward, with the right fingertips touching the upper edge of one upright square ceramic slab seated securely in a shallow wooden groove. Three large geometric glaze samples stand separately on the bench, with broad opaque flat-color faces and crisp edges. Behind the artist, a huge planar backdrop is divided by a straight diagonal boundary rising from lower left to upper right: saturated cobalt blue occupies the upper-left field and saturated vermilion occupies the lower-right field. The muted gray clothing and subdued skin remain clearly separated from this vivid two-color environment. Compose a medium-wide frontal photograph that shows the entire diagonal division, both hands and the bench supports. The slab arrangement repeats large clearly bounded color blocks at a smaller scale, with controlled reflections preserving each flat hue. Use soft neutral frontal light on the face and a directional side light revealing the ceramic thickness. The visual priorities are the muted subject against the vivid environment, a legible diagonal color split, and distinct geometric color blocking; the ceramic artist remains the focal figure.
